fusions.name: Rootbind
fusions.desc: Sends a seed bolt that deals 10 damage with a 50% chance of [Pinned] for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to enemies within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Pollen Burst
fusions.desc: Looses a cone of pollen 5 tiles long, dealing 3 damage to everything in it and making them [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Grazing Ground
fusions.desc: Raises a patch of grass where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Deep Roots
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 10%. It also regenerates 1 health a second, permanently.
